sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The RB-MP13 key (RB-MP13) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to one of the Federal State Reserve Agency base Service and Repair Center workshop rooms.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: First floor of the eastern repair point building on Reserve. The building is labeled with a white chess knight on it. (Highlighted in green)

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- Loose loot (Tools)
- One Drawer
- Possible spawn for 6-STEN-140-M military battery
- Intelligence folder spawn on the chair beside the desk
